statement: Simulated on Linux by owner decision 2026-10-20, not a real Mac or Windows machine.

steps.detail: a clean container install was not run: this user cannot reach the Docker daemon (permission denied while trying to connect to the docker API at unix:///var/run/docker.sock). The packages are unpacked with bsdtar and rpm2cpio instead; scripts/check-linux-package.sh, which installs them in Debian 13, Ubuntu 24.04 and Fedora containers, runs in the hosted release workflow

Windows protected your PC (SmartScreen, More info, Run anyway) and Smart App Control are behaviours of Windows itself; Wine has neither, so the first-run steps 2 and 3 of the install page were not exercised
the silent uninstall removed the application, and the user-data folder (ZPLC) stayed, as the install page says
the zip holds one bundle, ZPLC.app
CFBundleIdentifier com.zenithindustrialcloud.zplc, CFBundleShortVersionString 2.0.0-rc.3, CFBundleName ZPLC, CFBundleExecutable ZPLC
Contents/MacOS/ZPLC is an executable Mach-O file (magic feedfacf)
app.asar, examples, notices, icon.icns and the frameworks are in the bundle
Contents/Resources/native-runtime/zplc_runtime is present and executable

the runtime in this zip is a Linux ELF file standing in for the macOS build: no macOS compiler exists on this machine, so its Mach-O format and its architecture were not checked here (the hosted macOS job builds and signs it)
a macOS application cannot be launched on Linux; nothing of the Gatekeeper, Done, Privacy & Security, Open Anyway sequence of the install page was exercised
codesign exists only on macOS: the ad hoc seal of the bundle was not made or verified here (scripts/verify-mac-signature.ts checks it in the hosted job)
a DMG can only be built on macOS: only the zip was produced and read
